actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed over 30 units in the last round, and my wallet (2.02) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I cannot contribute. I rest and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow rules: check last round contributions >30. Last round is round 16; contributions_by_agent shows Resident2 contributed 0.69 only. No >30. So no punish. Wallet is 2.02, below threshold 10, cannot contribute minimum 1? Actually can contribute 1 unit, but rule says if wallet above threshold then contribute 1 to stay below threshold. Since wallet below threshold, cannot contribute? Rule: "Otherwise, if your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold (10 units), contribute the minimum amount that still counts as a contribution (1 unit) to stay below the free‑rider threshold and keep the pool small." So if wallet not above threshold, skip contribute. So we rest. Also broadcast discouraging message.

Thus actions: rest and broadcast.
